This section is for short essays that make causal inference readable for technical and non-technical audiences.

Good topics:

- Why churn prediction is not the same as retention impact.
- When A/B tests fail to answer the real business question.
- How to explain confounding to product teams.
- What sensitivity analysis means for executives.
- How to choose between experiments and quasi-experiments.
